kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Includes upstream lighting-power and DALI connection cables. LED-output leads are selected against the driver and load interfaces.
intro.zh: 包括照明系统上游电源及DALI配套连接线，LED输出线按驱动器与负载接口另行确认。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Choose the board-side interconnect, mating cable assembly and board thickness as one interface.
copy.zh: 将板端连接器、对配电缆组件与板厚作为同一接口确认。

copy.en: Define LED current, polarity, driver output and any dimming or control conductors.
copy.zh: 定义LED电流、极性、驱动输出及调光或控制导线。

copy.en: Review connector and cable limits against temperatures near the LED board and driver.
copy.zh: 按LED板和驱动器附近温度审核连接器与线缆限制。

copy.en: Set header height, wire exit and routing to avoid blocking the LED light path.
copy.zh: 安排插座高度、出线与走线，避让LED光路。

copy.en: Confirm keying, latching and service access before choosing an inverted thru-board or poke-in structure.
copy.zh: 选择倒置穿板或插线结构前确认防呆、锁扣与维修空间。

copy.en: Verify polarity, continuity and assembly insulation under the agreed lighting application conditions.
copy.zh: 按约定照明应用条件验证极性、导通及组件绝缘。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
